# superset_row_level_security (Resource)

Manages a Row-Level Security (RLS) filter rule within Apache Superset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superset_row_level_security" "vn_filter" {
  name        = "VN_Sales_Only"
  description = "Filter sales data for Vietnam analysts"
  filter_type = "Regular"
  clause      = "country = 'VN'"
  tables      = [1]
  roles       = [superset_role.analyst.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `clause` (String) The SQL filter clause injected into queries (e.g., "country = 'VN'" or "department_id = 12").
- `name` (String) Name of the RLS rule.
- `tables` (List of Number) List of dataset/table IDs to which this RLS rule applies.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description explaining what this RLS rule filters.
- `filter_type` (String) The filter type: 'Regular' (applies to specified roles) or 'Base' (applies to all except specified roles). Defaults to 'Regular'.
- `roles` (List of Number) List of role IDs to associate with this RLS rule.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the RLS rule as a string.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import RLS rule by numeric ID
terraform import superset_row_level_security.vn_filter 5
```
